notes: Strategy derived from jury verdicts: ZERO weak points across all criteria + ONE strong, legible civic idea.

Rewarded: permeable public ground floor / forum (≥12 of 19 verdicts), restraint & timeless proportion, economy, respectful dialogue with heritage, council hall as a visible symbol with flawless access, flexible grid, timber-concrete hybrid, re-use.

Penalised: scale jumps, rootless iconic forms, alien or too many materials, glass curtain walls (overheating, mirror effect), poor access to the council hall, gimmicky eco claims, costs at the upper limit.
Presentation: credibility beats spectacle — calm daylight realism with neighbours in frame; white-model photos; text consistent with drawings.
Clarifications fully summarised (21 answers); form tables F.14.B / F.15.A–C structure extracted for automatic filling from the model.
